description: US: the required minimum distribution (RMD) for this year from a traditional IRA, 401(k) or 403(b): the 31 December balance of last year divided by the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table divisor for the age reached this year (Pub 590-B Table III: 26.5 at 73, 24.6 at 75, 20.2 at 80), the RMD start age by birth year (73 for 1951-1958, 75 for 1960 or later, 1959 not set by the final regulation 26 CFR 1.401(a)(9)-2), and the next years at a growth rate. Not for a spouse more than 10 years younger who is the sole beneficiary (Joint Life table). Use this when someone asks how much they must withdraw, when RMDs start or what the RMD divisor is.

balance.description: Account balance on 31 December last year, USD

birthYear.description: Year of birth (sets the start age)

growthPct.description: Growth for the projection, percent a year (default 5)
